description: This file defines the interface IFrontPanel for controlling and querying a front panel device, including methods for brightness, lights, LEDs, and blinking patterns.

classes.name: IFrontPanel
classes.description: Interface for front panel control with methods for configuration, brightness, lights, LEDs, and blinking patterns.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the front panel with the provided service.

methods.name: GetBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the brightness level for a given index.

methods.name: GetFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported front panel lights and related info.

methods.name: SetBlink
methods.description: Sets a blink pattern for an LED based on a JSON string.

methods.name: SetBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness for a specified LED.

methods.name: SetLED
methods.description: Sets the color and brightness of a specified LED.
